description: This file defines an abstract test class for ensuring implementations of the Psr"log"LoggerInterface comply with expected behavior. It provides various test methods to verify logging levels, message formatting, exception handling, and context data processing.

classes.name: LoggerInterfaceTest
classes.description: An abstract PHPUnit test class for validating LoggerInterface implementations to ensure they behave according to PSR-3 specifications.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the logger instance being tested.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve log messages generated during tests.

methods.name: testImplements
methods.description: Verifies that the logger instance implements the LoggerInterface.

methods.name: testLogsAtAllLevels
methods.description: Tests logging at various severity levels to ensure correct message formatting.

methods.name: provideLevelsAndMessages
methods.description: Provides data for testing log messages at different levels.

methods.name: testThrowsOnInvalidLevel
methods.description: Verifies that invalid log levels throw the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testContextReplacement
methods.description: Tests that message placeholders in logs are correctly replaced with context data.

methods.name: testObjectCastToString
methods.description: Checks that objects with __toString() methods are correctly cast to strings in logs.

methods.name: testContextCanContainAnything
methods.description: Ensures that various data types can be included in the logging context without errors.

methods.name: testContextExceptionKeyCanBeExceptionOrOtherValues
methods.description: Verifies that the 'exception' key in context can be an exception object or other values.
